findings.issue: Four consecutive writes of this file (trace turns 50-53); the middle three contained placeholder/garbage code the agent itself flagged, wasting three turns
findings.suggestion: Compose complete file contents and self-review before writing, or write in smaller verifiable units so a bad generation is caught by build immediately

findings.issue: Background-server management was sloppy: the pid file captured the wrong pid (compound `&` command), and pkill -f 'node build' killed its own shell, causing a ~7-turn detour debugging a fix that had already worked
findings.suggestion: Start servers with a single backgrounded command and record $! directly (e.g. `nohup node build & echo $!`), or verify liveness with a port probe before debugging app code

findings.issue: Duplicate buildCard/hiddenCard builders flagged for cleanup in turn 47 ('clean later') were never removed
findings.suggestion: Collapse hiddenCard into buildCard(id, name, hidden) or delete the note along with the dead code

findings.issue: Whitespace between the ability link and '(hidden)' marker relies on an   entity workaround rather than a structural fix
findings.suggestion: Wrap the marker in its own element (e.g. (hidden)) with a margin, keeping text robust regardless of whitespace collapsing

findings.issue: Three successive rewrites of the home page reactivity (state_referenced_locally warning, then autofixer suggestions) before landing the final derived-based pattern
findings.suggestion: Run svelte-autofixer/check on the pattern before writing it, saving one or two iterations

findings.issue: No svelte-check/typecheck was ever run (0 typechecks measured); JS-only project lowers the risk but $props/data contracts went unverified
findings.suggestion: Run svelte-check once after scaffolding and once before finishing

summary: A well-run session: exhaustive upfront reading of spec, tests, data and design references produced the right architecture with essentially no requirement rework, and verification was exemplary (full suite green after the last edit, screenshot comparison to references, programmatic a11y probes, autofixer-clean components). The main waste was a garbage-generation loop on one file and self-inflicted background-process confusion that cost roughly ten turns. Debugging, when things actually failed, was systematic and cause-based.
